project.name: Reference 1.4um BSI Split-PD Pixel
project.description: Open-source image-sensor pixel design studio project using proxy stack geometry, Meep optical generation maps, Gmsh-native DEVSIM split-PD solves, and camera-LUT oriented reports.

optical.primary_result: G(x, depth) and G(x, depth, z)
optical.current_scope: 3D RGB r84 native-DEVSIM research LUT with direct x-axis, z-axis, and diagonal CRA anchors plus high-resolution 2D r72/r84 split/OCL crosstalk x-section. Legacy CRA5 r20 and r70/r80 CRA3 LUTs remain trend-only.

electrical.primary_result: split-PD cathode current deltas on Gmsh-native 2D mesh
electrical.current_scope: profile-ppd proxy model; primary optical-response sweeps use PD-only FD feature scale 0, while TG/FD-specific behavior remains in separate transfer/transient diagnostics

coupling_next.method: Primary direct DEVSIM solve from FDTD G(x,depth), plus G*W surrogate diagnostics
coupling_next.reason: Split-PD left/right response is not reliably reconstructed by sparse local DD-probe superposition. The primary camera-system response artifact therefore uses native DEVSIM terminal-current deltas from the full imported FDTD generation map. G*W_proxy, W_mesh, W_devsim_laplace, and W_devsim_dd_probe remain available as speed-oriented surrogate diagnostics and are accepted only when their error gates pass against native_devsim.

crosstalk_kernel.method: Simulate a guarded OCL/pixel neighborhood, illuminate the center output cell, and integrate Si absorption in binned output cells plus raw PD cells.
crosstalk_kernel.reason: This replaces analytic crosstalk proxy values with a real finite-array FDTD kernel. Current support truncation is low for the largest exported kernels, but resolution convergence and grid feature gates fail because the Si internal wavelength and DTI/passivation features are under-resolved at the smoke resolutions.

crosstalk_xsection.method: Solve a finite x-y cross-section at 72 and 84 px/um, using the same optical stack, CRA-x source phase, DTI geometry, and split-PD/OCL layouts.
crosstalk_xsection.reason: This resolves the numerical grid blocker for CRA-x lateral crosstalk on a practical local mesh: 84 px/um gives 11.33 grid pixels per Si internal wavelength at 550 nm and 3.36 pixels on the 40 nm lens-edge feature. Full 3D OCL footprint convergence still needs a separate heavy run or calibrated reduction.

Full resolution/time/PML convergence is not yet proven for RGB r84.
